mapper.sql: SELECT f.*, (f.manual_required_count = f.manual_reviewed_count) AS manual_review_completed, (f.ai_failed_count > 0) AS ai_has_failure, CASE WHEN f.results_released = 1 AND f.score_published = 1 THEN 'RELEASED' WHEN f.results_released = 0 AND f.score_published = 0 THEN 'UNRELEASED' ELSE 'INCONSISTENT' END AS release_status FROM () f
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(t.manual_review_completed = 0), 0) AS pending_review, COALESCE(SUM(t.manual_review_completed = 1), 0) AS reviewed, COALESCE(SUM(t.manual_review_completed = 1 AND t.release_status != 'RELEASED'), 0) AS pending_release, COALESCE(SUM(t.release_status = 'RELEASED'), 0) AS released, COALESCE(SUM(t.ai_has_failure = 1), 0) AS ai_failed, COALESCE(SUM(t.ai_not_configured_count > 0), 0) AS ai_not_configured, COALESCE(SUM(t.ai_no_result_count > 0), 0) AS ai_no_result FROM () t
